original_subject: What did seven days of attention reveal?
candidate_subject: Eight cups. One useful kind of doubt.
candidate_preheader: Fisher’s 1935 tea test and a better way to read your seven-day focus notes.

claims.fact: In 1935 Fisher described a proposed eight-cup randomized classification test, four cups each preparation.
There are C(8,4)=70 allocations. Probability of perfect classification under the specified guessing model is 1/70.
Retrospective accounts disagree about the purported real tea-tasting outcome.
Current WordPress welcome identifies a 52-page free Fieldbook at /focus/; actual welcome receipt is not verified.
A seven-day unsystematic personal log cannot by itself establish an audio product's efficacy.
